limitations: Exploratory evaluation. The evaluator inspected the target before freezing this protocol; the target is withheld from generation calls, not unknown to the evaluator.
2011 lecture summaries are used with 2010 assessments. This is cross-semester development evidence, not chronological prediction of a future test.
Public MIT assessments may occur in model training data; pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out.
Both arms use identical student-selected slots and sources. Analysis, review and repair are VERA's extra operations; this is a workflow comparison, not equal compute.
The real MIT quiz includes 3D projections, least squares/QR, and general n-by-n reasoning beyond VERA's supported domain.
Numerical checks do not establish full correctness of natural-language solutions, conceptual originality, or learning outcomes.
The separate held-out solve measures the underlying Meta model, not VERA's generation pipeline. Official solutions are excluded from that solve.
Keep all failed attempts in the denominator. Do not silently replace a failure or rerun an existing batch. Any changed protocol needs a new batch ID.
Follow-up configuration selected after the initial 9000-token/default-effort batch exposed truncation. Report both versions; this is development iteration, not a fresh confirmatory benchmark.
